title: nephrodium filix-mas var. crenatum
intro: Nephrodium filix-mas var. crenatum, commonly known as the crenated lady fern, is a type of fern plant that belongs to the family Dryopteridaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to alleviate symptoms of conditions such as arthritis and respiratory issues. The crenated lady fern is said to possess therapeutic actions such as immune system modulation, anti-allergic, and anti-microbial activities, making it a potential remedy for various health concerns. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and polysaccharides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and health benefits.
